name: NSF Award Search API
known_limitations: NSF awards show funded research activity and institutional recipients, not research success, peer-reviewed results, or deployment readiness.
automation_notes: Use award dates, directorates, program names, organizations, and keywords to select bounded research-funding records.
notes: Phase 49 research funding rail. Phase 50B selected award 2433348, AI-Materials Institute (AI-MI), to Cornell University; the award establishes funding and proposed scope, not scientific results or portal delivery. Phase 53 rechecked the exact API record on 2026-07-22 and confirmed the award recipient, dates, cooperative-agreement type, $6 million obligated, and $20 million estimated total.
